probes.question: On what date did the author sit down with Elizabeth Harmon for the interview?
verbatim: we sat down with Elizabeth Harmon, a compliance expert with over 20 years of experience in the field, on October 15, 2023

probes.question: According to Elizabeth, what can the consequences of non-compliance range from?
probes.answer: From fines to the closure of the business
verbatim: and the consequences of non-compliance can be severe, ranging from fines to the closure of your business.

probes.question: What did Elizabeth say has happened since November 2023 in the Awareness stage of the compliance lifecycle?
probes.answer: There has been a surge in environmental regulations affecting local businesses
verbatim: Elizabeth mentioned that since November 2023, there has been a surge in environmental regulations affecting local businesses

probes.question: What did the financial pressures on small businesses lead to in the last quarter of 2023?
probes.answer: The closure of several small businesses
verbatim: We discussed how these financial pressures had led to the closure of several small businesses in the last quarter of 2023.

probes.question: What did Elizabeth recommend for building relationships with the local business community?
probes.answer: Joining chambers of commerce or industry associations
verbatim: including joining chambers of commerce or industry associations
